why: Own It, Learn It, Share It is a context-specific instructional design framework that combines existing constructivist, constructionist, and self-determination theories with design guidelines rather than proposing a distinct general learning theory.
Lee and Hannafin's Own It, Learn It, and Share It is a named student-centered learning design framework rather than a general explanatory learning theory.
name: Own It, Learn It, and Share It design framework
product_description: A design framework developed by Lee and Hannafin for structuring student-centered learning around learners owning, learning, and sharing their learning, including in online and technology-supported environments.

why: Own It, Learn It, and Share It is a named three-step course-design framework for K–12 online learning, not a general learning theory.
name: Own It, Learn It, and Share It design framework
product_description: A student-centered online-learning course-design framework developed by Lee and Hannafin that guides learners through owning goals, learning with instructional support, and sharing a completed artifact for feedback.
